name: state-store
description: Local state for workflows: seen-id sets with TTL for polling (filter_unseen), JSON key/values and atomic counters, in JSON files

nodes.title: Filter unseen ids
nodes.description: Return the ids not seen before in this namespace (`new_ids`, in input order). With mark=true (default) every given id is marked seen in the same atomic step, so a later or overlapping run never gets them again. For at-least-once processing use mark=false, then mark_seen after the items were handled.

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

ids.description: Item ids (strings, or integers; at most 10000, each 1-256 bytes as UTF-8). Duplicates are ignored.

mark.description: Mark the given ids seen in the same step (default true)

ttl_days.description: Days an id stays seen after it was last marked (default 90)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Mark ids seen
nodes.description: Mark ids seen in this namespace. Ids already seen get a fresh expiry. When the namespace holds over 100000 ids the least recently seen are dropped (`dropped_count`).

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

ids.description: Item ids (strings, or integers; at most 10000, each 1-256 bytes as UTF-8). Duplicates are ignored.

ttl_days.description: Days an id stays seen after it was last marked (default 90)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Is id seen
nodes.description: Check whether one id is seen (and not expired) in this namespace, with when it was first seen and when it expires.

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

item_id.description: Item id (named item_id because `id` is the node id in workflows)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Forget seen ids
nodes.description: Remove ids from the seen set, so filter_unseen reports them as new again.

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

ids.description: Item ids (strings, or integers; at most 10000, each 1-256 bytes as UTF-8). Duplicates are ignored.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get value
nodes.description: Read a key's JSON value. Returns found=false (value null) when the key is missing or expired.

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Set value
nodes.description: Store a JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean or null; at most 1 MB) under a key, replacing any old value. Optional ttl_seconds.

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional: the key expires this many seconds after it is written

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete key
nodes.description: Delete a key. Returns deleted=false when it did not exist (or had expired).

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List keys
nodes.description: List keys (sorted, optionally only those starting with `prefix`) with their update and expiry times. Values are not included; use get.

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Increment counter
nodes.description: Atomically add `by` (default 1, may be negative) to an integer value and return the new value. A missing or expired key starts at 0; ttl_seconds applies only when the counter is created, so a counter with a TTL counts within a fixed window.

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

ttl_seconds.description: Optional: the key expires this many seconds after it is written

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List namespaces
nodes.description: List the namespaces in the store (sorted) with their file size and last modification time.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Clear namespace
nodes.description: Delete a namespace's file: all its seen ids and keys. Workflow node only (never an agent tool).

namespace.description: Namespace (1-64 chars: a-z, 0-9, _ . -; e.g. `instagram-comments`). Each namespace is one file.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
